cone-of-cold.material: A small crystal or glass cone.
cone-of-cold.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

planar-binding.material: A jewel worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.
planar-binding.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of a higher level, the duration increases to 10 days with a 6th-level slot, to 30 days with a 7th-level slot, to 180 days with an 8th-level slot, and to a year and a day with a 9th-level spell slot.

summon-draconic-spirit.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

summon-celestial.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

creation.material: A tiny piece of matter of the same type of the item you plan to create.
creation.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the cube increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 5th.

danse-macabre.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you animate up to two additional corpses for each slot level above 5th.

negative-energy-flood.material: A broken bone and a square of black silk.

dispel-evil-and-good.material: Holy water or powdered silver and iron.

dominate-person.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 6th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. When you use a 7th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 1 hour. When you use a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

enervation.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 4d8;2d8 for each slot level above 5th.

awaken.material: An agate worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.

insect-plague.material: A few grains of sugar, some kernels of grain, and a smear of fat.
insect-plague.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 5th.

hold-monster.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a level 6 or higher location, you can target an additional creature for each level of location beyond the fifth. The creatures must be within 30 feet o f each other when you target them.

conjure-elemental.material: Burning incense for air, soft clay for earth, sulfur and phosphorus for fire, or water and sand for water.
conjure-elemental.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 5th.

conjure-volley.material: One piece of ammunition or one thrown weapon.

telepathic-bond.material: Pieces of eggshell from two different kinds of creatures

maelstrom.material: Paper or leaf in the shape of a funnel.

arcane-hand.material: An eggshell and a snakeskin glove.
arcane-hand.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage from the clenched fist option increases by 2d8 and the damage from the grasping hand increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 5th.

modify-memory.higherLevel: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you can alter the target's memories of an event that took place up to 7 days ago (6th level), 30 days ago (7th level), 1 year ago (8th level), or any time in the creature's past (9th level).

wall-of-force.material: A pinch of powder made by crushing a clear gemstone.

wall-of-light.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 4d8 for each slot level above 5th.

legend-lore.material: Incense worth at least 250 gp, which the spell consumes, and four ivory strips worth at least 50 gp each.

geas.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th or 8th level, the duration is 1 year. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 9th level, the spell lasts until it is ended by one of the spells mentioned above.

raise-dead.material: A diamond worth at least 500 gp, which the spell consumes.

reincarnate.material: Rare oils and unguents worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.

greater-restoration.material: Diamond dust worth at least 100 gp, which the spell consumes.

hallow.material: Herbs, oils, and incense worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.

scrying.material: A focus worth at least 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, a silver mirror, or a font filled with holy water.

mass-cure-wounds.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

dream.material: A handful of sand, a dab of ink, and a writing quill plucked from a sleeping bird.

soul-cage.castingTime: 1 reaction, which you take when a humanoid you can see within 60 feet of you dies

circle-of-death.material: The powder of a crushed black pearl worth at least 500 gp.
circle-of-death.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 2d6 for each slot level above 6th.

chain-lightning.material: A bit of fur; a piece of amber, glass, or a crystal rod; and three silver pins.
chain-lightning.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, one additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each slot level above 6th.

summon-fiend.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, use the higher level wherever the spell's level appears in the stat block.

create-undead.material: One clay pot filled with grave dirt, one clay pot filled with brackish water, and one 150 gp black onyx stone for each corpse.
create-undead.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four ghouls. When you cast this spell using an 8th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five ghouls or two ghasts or wights. When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six ghouls, three ghasts or wights, or two mummies.

disintegrate.material: A lodestone and a pinch of dust.
disintegrate.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 3d6 for each slot level above 6th.

heroes-feast.material: A gem-encrusted bowl worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.

globe-of-invulnerability.material: A glass or crystal bead that shatters when the spell ends.
globe-of-invulnerability.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the barrier blocks spells of one level higher for each slot level above 6th.

heal.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the amount of healing increases by 10 for each slot level above 6th.

programmed-illusion.material: A bit of fleece and jade dust worth at least 25 gp.

forbiddance.material: A sprinkling of holy water, rare incense, and powdered ruby worth at least 1,000 gp.

conjure-fey.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 6th.

wall-of-thorns.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, both types of damage increase by 1d8 for each slot level above 6th.

wall-of-ice.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage the wall deals when it appears increases by 2d6, and the damage from passing through the sheet of frigid air increases by 1d6, for each slot level above 6th.

bones-of-the-earth.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you can create two additional pillars for each slot level above 6th.

flesh-to-stone.material: A pinch of lime, water, and earth.

contingency.material: A statuette of yourself carved from ivory and decorated with gems worth at least 1,500 gp.

guards-and-wards.material: Burning incense, a small measure of brimstone and oil, a knotted string, a small amount of umber hulk blood, and a small silver rod worth at least 10 gp.

find-the-path.material: A set of divinatory tools--such as bones, ivory sticks, cards, teeth, or carved runes--worth 100 gp and an object from the location you wish to find.

freezing-sphere.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 6th.

mass-suggestion.material: A snake's tongue and either a bit of honeycomb or a drop of sweet oil.
mass-suggestion.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, the duration is 10 days. When you use an 8th-level spell slot, the duration is 30 days. When you use a 9th-level spell slot, the duration is a year and a day.

move-earth.material: An iron blade and a small bag containing a mixture of soils--clay, loam, and sand.

tenser-s-transformation.material: A few hairs from a bull.

magic-jar.material: A gem, crystal, reliquary, or some other ornamental container worth at least 500 gp.

true-seeing.material: An ointment for the eyes that costs 25 gp; is made from mushroom powder, saffron, and fat; and is consumed by the spell.

delayed-blast-fireball.material: A tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur.
delayed-blast-fireball.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the base damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 7th.

plane-shift.material: A forked, metal rod worth at least 250 gp, attuned to a particular plane of existence.

crown-of-stars.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, the number of motes created increases by two for each slot level above 7th.

sequester.material: A powder composed of diamond, emerald, ruby, and sapphire dust worth at least 5,000 gp, which the spell consumes.

arcane-sword.material: A miniature platinum sword with a grip and pommel of copper and zinc, worth 250 gp.

etherealness.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 8th level or higher, you can target up to three willing creatures (including you) for each slot level above 7th. The creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell.

conjure-celestial.higherLevel: When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you summon a celestial of challenge rating 5 or lower.

magnificent-mansion.material: A miniature portal carved from ivory, a small piece of polished marble, and a tiny silver spoon, each item worth at least 5 gp.

project-image.material: A small replica of you made from materials worth at least 5 gp.

regenerate.material: A prayer wheel and holy water.

resurrection.material: A diamond worth at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.

simulacrum.material: Snow or ice in quantities sufficient to made a life-size copy of the duplicated creature; some hair, fingernail clippings, or other piece of that creature's body placed inside the snow or ice; and powdered ruby worth 1,500 gp, sprinkled over the duplicate and consumed by the spell.

dream-of-the-blue-veil.material: A magic item or a willing creature from the destination world.

symbol.material: Mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal with a total value of at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes.

holy-aura.material: A tiny reliquary worth at least 1,000 gp containing a sacred relic, such as a scrap of cloth from a saint's robe or a piece of parchment from a religious text.

antipathy-sympathy.material: Either a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for the antipathy effect or a drop of honey for the sympathy effect.

antimagic-field.material: A pinch of powdered iron or iron filings.

clone.material: A diamond worth at least 1,000 gp and at least 1 cubic inch of flesh of the creature that is to be cloned, which the spell consumes, and a vessel worth at least 2,000 gp that has a sealable lid and is large enough to hold a Medium creature, such as a huge urn, coffin, mud-filled cyst in the ground, or crystal container filled with salt water.

control-weather.material: Burning incense and bits of earth and wood mixed in water.

dominate-monster.higherLevel: When you cast this spell with a 9th-level spell slot, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

sunburst.material: Fire and a piece of sunstone.

feeblemind.material: A handful of clay, crystal, glass, or mineral spheres.

telepathy.material: A pair of linked silver rings.

maddening-darkness.material: A drop of pitch mixed with a drop of mercury.

earthquake.material: A pinch of dirt, a piece of rock, and a lump of clay.

shapechange.material: A jade circlet worth at least 1,500 gp, which you must place on your head before you cast the spell.

imprisonment.material: A vellum depiction or a carved statuette in the likeness of the target, and a special component that varies according to the version of the spell you choose, worth at least 500 gp per Hit Die of the target.

true-polymorph.material: A drop of mercury, a dollop of gum arabic, and a wisp of smoke.

gate.material: A diamond worth at least 5,000 gp.

astral-projection.material: For each creature you affect with this spell, you must provide one jacinth worth at least 1,000 gp and one ornately carved bar of silver worth at least 100 gp, all of which the spell consumes.

true-resurrection.material: A sprinkle of holy water and diamonds worth at least 25,000 gp, which the spell consumes.
